comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
All 6 player nations have one permanent "New World" colony. They are:

Pernambuco for Portuguese (E. Coast of Latin America permit required)
Willemstad for Dutch (same as above)
Cayenne for French (same as above)
Caracas for Venetian (same as above)
Grand Cayman for English (Caribbean port permit required)
Trujillo for Spanish (same as Grand Cayman)

This ring (and some other goodies) can be bought from any of these towns' item shops, once you've invested 200k-ish ducats in them.

comments.author: Lisa
comments.body: Actually Hans Grand Cayman and Trujillo requires E. Coast of Latin America permit not Caribbean. I remembered trying to get into Grand Cayman without port permit for E.Coast and it wouldn't let me enter the town.

wiki:
Available from the Item Shop of the following cities:

Cayenne - France
Pernambuco - Portugal
Grand Cayman - England
Willemstad - The Netherlands
Trujillo - Spain
Caracas - Venice

Price: 7,000,000 ducats
Note: an investment of 240,000 ducats is required before it can be purchased. Remember, you can only invest in a city that belongs to your nation.

** This is one of 5 items required for Trade Level 65 Event - the others are:

Turquoise Brooch
Amber Hair Ornament
Agate Earring
Diamond Necklace
